name: Spanish transposing corneta section (Esencia)

variants.name: Honsuy Do/Re-flat cornetas, first through third parts
Enrique León tenor transposing cornetas, extended tubing, Fa/Do/Si-flat lower register

description: The two documented corneta constructions coexist in Esencia. Upper Honsuy Do/Re-flat cornetas plus custom tenor transposing cornetas designed by Enrique León. The latter extends tubing to trumpet-like total length but remains the source-described keyed/transposing corneta; neither a valved English cornet nor nineteenth-century Royal Kent keyed bugle. Harmonic voice labels are instrumental parts, not singers. Source does not supply alloy/mouthpiece dimensions; none invented. Neutral authored axes.
